title: The Juniper EX switch must not use the default VLAN for management traffic.
fixtext:
Configure the switch for management access to use a VLAN other than the default VLAN.

set interfaces <interface name> unit 0 family ethernet-switching interface-mode access
set interfaces <interface name> unit 0 family ethernet-switching vlan members <vlan name>
VulnDiscussion: By default, all unassigned interfaces are placed into the default VLAN and if used for management, could unintentionally expose sensitive traffic or protected resources to unauthorized devices.
